regime.label: Transition — Valuation Guard Active
drivers: Valuation guard BLOCKS a growth-additive regime: Shiller CAPE 42.0 ≥ 40 — dot-com-peak territory. Top-20 concentration 50.8% ≥ 45% — index-level single-theme risk. Adding to growth at a historic valuation extreme is not what a confirmed benign regime should instruct. Routing to the transition overlay instead.

exposure.why: New campaign: no closed swing trades yet. Procedure Part 3 starts every campaign at 0.5% risk regardless of how good the setups look.
